dedupe_keys.name: jiaxing electric vehicle charging transactions and preprocessing

description: The EV transaction dataset research team publishes charging records with supporting metadata and preprocessing code. The Figshare release identifies user-behaviour and charging-fault analysis as intended uses and provides separate data and Python-code archives under CC BY 4.0 at no cost. The descriptor concerns Jiaxing, China; the repository itself gives limited detail about exact observation dates and station coverage. Human-readable metadata are supplied in CSV format. The resource can help calibrate charging-demand, fault and tariff-response simulations, with data-urbanev-shenzhen-ev-charging providing a separate city benchmark and model-pypsa supporting grid studies. A caveat is that transactions observed by participating stations do not represent all journeys or charging opportunities. Code and data contents were not downloaded, so field completeness, preprocessing choices and reported transaction totals remain unchecked at file level.
